originalTitle: U.S. stock futures dip as investors await inflation data, grapple with more Iran uncertainty
summary: U.S. stock-index futures were little changed on Sunday, after new demands from Iran raised fresh doubts about the Strait of Hormuz reopening anytime soon and as investors await key inflation data later this week.

chineseTitle: 由于投资者等待通胀数据并应对伊朗更多的不确定性，美国股指期货下跌
chineseSummary: 周日，美国股指期货几乎没有变化，此前伊朗的新要求引发了人们对霍尔木兹海峡很快重新开放的新疑虑，而且投资者正在等待本周晚些时候的关键通胀数据。
